governing_principle: Many inputs, few authoritative outputs. Detailed factors may inform a channel, but cannot become additional independent utility knobs unless they represent a validated residual not already captured elsewhere.

authoritative_outputs.description: What the move does to the team's current-season competitive strength.
What the move does to expected future franchise/asset value.
prohibited_duplicate_outputs: generic youth bonus on top of market value

authoritative_outputs.description: How easily the resulting portfolio can be converted into other useful assets without material concession.
existing_authoritative_evidence: explicitly authorized residual liquidity deltas only
prohibited_duplicate_outputs: manager activity treated as focal economic value

authoritative_outputs.description: How well the roster remains functional under future/stress availability changes beyond current lineup/simulator effects.
existing_authoritative_evidence: explicitly authorized residual resilience deltas only
prohibited_duplicate_outputs: starter dependency already in current block

package_substitution_rule.description: Quantity-for-quality economics are a transformation of the FUTURE_ASSET_VALUE coordinate for negotiated trade packages, not a fifth additive utility channel.

non_economic_layers.note: These determine whether a useful trade is realistic, not whether it is valuable to the focal team.
May explain a result without independently changing the final score.

simplification_targets.rationale: Broad umbrella mixes need, endowment, starter/depth, performance, usage, injury and utility. Each sub-signal should map to one channel or remain diagnostic/search-only.
Same-source rank repricing is redundant. Residual package concentration lives only in PACKAGE-CONCENTRATION-RESIDUAL-001.
Market-tier scarcity duplicates market value; team-specific replacement evidence belongs under current or resilience depending on horizon.
Do not create a second portfolio adjustment if simulator/lineup/resilience channels already capture the effect.
